text:
The dish looks like a paper plate about 20 cm across (roughly 260 px wide in the image), so I used that as the ruler.

It holds about 20 grapes, mostly red with 2-3 green. Each grape looks about 2.5 cm long, which puts it at roughly 5-6 g. Twenty grapes at that weight come to about 110-120 g, and I allowed a little extra for larger grapes, giving about 120 g.

Grapes provide about 0.69 kcal/g, so 120 g is about 83 kcal.
